title: 十二公分
subject: a weather observer halfway through his shift at the Yushan North Peak weather station, measuring the winter's first snow with a ruler at five in the morning, reading the numbers down to the base over the radio, and losing his biscuits to a yellow-throated marten
caption: Mandarin slowcore in the 1990s American slowcore vein. A clean electric guitar through a slow amp tremolo, strumming open chords once and letting each one ring out, a second guitar adding soft volume swells, a sparse round bass holding long root notes, drums played with mallets and brushes at a crawl, and a low organ drone underneath. Quiet, roomy late-night recording with natural room reverb and long gaps between notes. Male voice, a low soft baritone, close-miked, plain and unhurried, almost spoken. 66 BPM, E major. Hushed, patient and quietly amused. No post-rock crescendo, no shoegaze fuzz, no orchestral strings, no trap drums, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, two ringing guitar chords]

[Verse 1]
清晨五點 三千八百公尺
我推開門 雪已經蓋過腳踝
蹲下來 拿尺 一格一格量
今年的第一場雪 十二公分

[Pre-Chorus]
回到屋裡 對著無線電
一個字一個字 唸給山下聽

[Chorus]
氣溫零下四度 西北風
積雪十二公分 天還沒亮
山下的人 都還在睡
醒來就會知道 下雪了

[Verse 2]
黃喉貂 又從屋頂溜下來
叼走我放在窗台的餅乾
這裡半個月 才換一次班
我跟牠講的話 比跟人還多

[Pre-Chorus]
中午雲散開 看得到主峰
我再走出去 把尺插進雪裡

[Chorus]
氣溫零下一度 風停了
積雪剩下九公分 屋簷在滴水
晚上的新聞 會用我拍的照片
山下的人 看了又會說 好想上來

[Bridge - guitar and organ drone only]
整座山 只有我的腳印
從門口 到百葉箱 再走回來

[Outro - guitar ringing out, mallets fading]
天又黑了 八點再量一次
手套 烤在暖爐旁邊
